title: HttpRequest
description: HTTP receptor archetype — request direction (server-side endpoint). Extends ReceptorArchetype. Identifies the server port that receives HTTP requests. The endpoint pattern and accepted methods define the API contract surface. Source: RFC 9110 §4 — Identifiers in HTTP, §7.1 — Determining the Target Resource.

endpointPattern.description: URI template pattern identifying this receptor's endpoint address (e.g., '/api/users/{id}'). Defines WHERE this port listens. Source: RFC 6570 (URI Template, 2012); RFC 9110 §4.

acceptedMethods.description: Set of HTTP methods this endpoint accepts. Non-redundant with HTTPRequest.method (single value per message): this is the port's complete capability declaration. Source: RFC 9110 §9 — Methods, §10.2.1 — Allow.
